strings.tl: Ah, so you are [HERO]. // My name is Angle, the strongest warrior in Asla Fael, the hero of Kars Bastide.

strings.jp:
{0b:08}{e080} 自{e085}最強の戦士アングル {e081}{0b:09}
君はここで待っていたのかい?
だけど、待ち合わせ場所は
{e086}{e087}じゃなかったかな。{1a}おっと、君のその頭では
覚えられなかったのかもしれないね。
無理なことを要求してすまない。{1a}私のように知性とたくましさを
併せ持つ戦士なんて
そうはいないのだからね。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{0b:08}【 自称最強の戦士アングル 】{0b:09}
君はここで待っていたのかい?
だけど、待ち合わせ場所は
教会じゃなかったかな。{1a}おっと、君のその頭では
覚えられなかったのかもしれないね。
無理なことを要求してすまない。{1a}私のように知性とたくましさを
併せ持つ戦士なんて

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Angle, Self-Styled Strongest 】{0b:09}
Have you been waiting here? But surely
our meeting place was the Church, was
it not?{1a}Oops, perhaps that head of yours could
not retain it. Forgive me for asking
the impossible.{1a}Warriors like me, who combine intellect
and brawn, are hard to come by,
after all.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Have you been waiting here? But surely our meeting place was the Church, was it not? // Oops, perhaps that head of yours could not retain it. Forgive me for asking the impossible. // Warriors like me, who combine intellect and brawn, are hard to come by, after all.

strings.jp:

じゃあ、ついてきたまえ。{0c:fe}
